services.title: Dental Fillings
services.short: Restore a tooth affected by decay or minor damage.
services.intro: Restore a tooth affected by decay or minor damage.
paragraphs: A filling replaces the damaged part of a tooth after decay has been removed. The aim is to restore its shape and everyday function while preserving healthy tooth structure.
An examination helps establish the extent of decay. Your dentist will discuss the filling material, comfort measures and care needed afterwards.
benefits: An examination and discussion of your concerns
A personalised plan with options explained
Guidance on treatment, aftercare and review
services.fit: Tooth decay, small cavities or a chipped tooth that needs assessment.

services.title: Root Canal Treatment
services.short: Care for an infected tooth with a focus on preserving it.
services.intro: Care for an infected tooth with a focus on preserving it.
paragraphs: Root canal treatment addresses inflammation or infection inside a tooth. The canals are cleaned, shaped and sealed, and the tooth may need a crown for protection.
Your dentist assesses the tooth and may recommend an X-ray before explaining the treatment plan. The number of visits and long-term outlook depend on the condition of the tooth.
benefits: An examination and discussion of your concerns
A personalised plan with options explained
Guidance on treatment, aftercare and review
services.fit: Persistent toothache, sensitivity or an infection requiring a dentist’s assessment.
services.alt: A dental team providing care in a treatment room

services.title: Wisdom Teeth Removal
services.short: A considered approach to troublesome wisdom teeth.
services.intro: A considered approach to troublesome wisdom teeth.
paragraphs: Wisdom teeth can sometimes become impacted or difficult to clean. Removal may be considered when they cause recurrent pain, infection or problems with adjacent teeth.
A clinical examination and imaging help your dentist assess the tooth’s position. The procedure, recovery and potential risks will be explained before treatment.
benefits: An examination and discussion of your concerns
A personalised plan with options explained
Guidance on treatment, aftercare and review
services.fit: Pain, swelling or repeated problems around a wisdom tooth.

services.intro: Explore options for a straighter smile and improved bite.
paragraphs: Braces and clear aligners guide teeth into a planned position over time. They may address crowding, spacing or bite concerns, depending on individual needs.
Orthodontic planning involves examining your teeth and bite. Your dentist will discuss suitable options, expected duration, reviews and retainers to help maintain the result.
benefits: An examination and discussion of your concerns
A personalised plan with options explained
Guidance on treatment, aftercare and review

services.intro: Discuss a fixed option for replacing missing teeth.
paragraphs: Dental implants are placed in the jaw to support replacement teeth. Treatment is planned around your oral health, available bone and the type of restoration you need.
Assessment may include imaging and a review of your medical history. The dentist will explain suitability, healing stages, alternatives and ongoing maintenance.
benefits: An examination and discussion of your concerns
A personalised plan with options explained

services.intro: Replace missing teeth with a personalised removable option.
paragraphs: Partial or complete dentures replace some or all missing teeth. Their design considers comfort, appearance and everyday activities such as speaking and eating.
Your dentist examines the mouth and discusses the best approach. Fitting may involve several visits and later adjustments as you become used to your dentures.

services.intro: Restore and protect teeth, or bridge a gap in your smile.
paragraphs: A crown covers a damaged tooth, while a bridge can replace a missing tooth using support from neighbouring teeth or implants. The right option depends on the condition of your mouth.
Your dentist discusses preparation, materials and alternatives. A carefully planned fit and regular maintenance support the restoration over time.

A visit may include a check-up, age-appropriate brushing guidance and a discussion of food habits. Any treatment is explained to parents or carers before proceeding.

paragraphs: Preventive dentistry combines check-ups, appropriate professional cleaning and daily oral hygiene. The aim is to identify concerns early and reduce the risk of decay and gum problems.
Your dentist can recommend a review schedule based on your needs and discuss brushing, cleaning between teeth and dietary habits. Prevention is a partnership between you and your dental team.

paragraphs: Gum treatment addresses inflammation and infection around the teeth. Early assessment is important because gum disease can progress even when discomfort is limited.
Your dentist examines the gums and supporting tissues. Care may include professional cleaning, deeper cleaning or specialist treatment, together with a personalised home-care plan.

services.intro: An examination for changes in the mouth that need attention.
paragraphs: Oral cancer screening involves checking the mouth for unusual changes. It is an assessment, not a guarantee that disease is absent; further investigation may be needed for a concerning finding.
Your dentist examines the oral tissues and asks about symptoms and risk factors. A persistent ulcer, lump or patch should be evaluated rather than ignored.

dentists.name: Dr. Pooja M. Sinha
bio: Dr. Pooja M. Sinha completed her dentistry at MJP Rohilkhand University, Bareilly, in 2004 and pursued her master’s degree in dentistry at Dr. Bheemrao Ambedkar University, Agra. Her training included exposure to developing quality dental services and orthognathic surgical cases.

Her clinic profile describes her role as a professor in Public Dentistry at Sardar Patel Post Graduate Institute of Dental and Medical Sciences since August 2013, teaching BDS students and guiding postgraduate research. It also notes her work as an external examiner for BDS and MDS examinations in 2021.

Her thesis and research received recognition at the national conference of the Indian Association of Forensic Odontology in 2011. Her interests include orthodontics, academics and tobacco cessation counseling. She places emphasis on patient comfort, clear communication and a considered approach to care.

dentists.name: Dr. Abhishek Sinha
bio: Born in Lucknow, Dr. Abhishek Sinha completed his MDS in Oral Medicine and Radiology at Saveetha Dental College, Chennai, under Dr. MGR Medical University, Tamil Nadu, in 2007. His dissertation examined the role of C-reactive protein in periodontal diseases.

His clinic profile describes him as a professor and head of Oral Medicine and Radiology at Sardar Patel Post Graduate Institute of Dental and Medical Sciences, Lucknow, with more than 15 years of undergraduate and postgraduate academic experience. It also describes him as a trained and certified implant dentist with national and international publications.

His areas of interest include oral mucosal abnormalities, oral cancer, salivary gland disorders and facial pain. The clinic highlights his care for children and patients whose medical conditions require additional treatment considerations, together with his emphasis on explaining problems and procedures clearly.
